[Opening Scene]: The video opens with the woman staying completely still, frozen in time in her seated position. Her pose—including arms or hand position completely locked in place. The camera moves around her static body in a single continuous tracking shot with no cuts or jump-edits.

The subject maintains the exact initial pose from <Picture 1> across all timestamps without shifting posture, moving limbs, or dropping moving arms. The camera moves in one continuous fluid motion, clipping smoothly through any wall or obstacle in its path.

The camera smoothly glides closer toward her upper chest with a slight downward tilt. Her entire body, arm poses, head position, remain completely motionless and fixed, eye gaze remain completely static and fixed straight ahead without turning or tracking.

The camera glides down capturing her back, seated buttocks down to her feet and shoes on the floor while clipping smoothly through any obstacles in its path.

As she is motionless, her eyes are completely motionless and locked in a fixed unmoving gaze straight ahead without turning or tracking. Her face expression, static gaze, and exact body pose remain completely locked, unchanged, and identical to <Picture 1> from start to finish.
